newsitem.title: FINLAND: NOKIA TO EXPANDS MOBILE RADIO PLANT.
newsitem.headline: NOKIA TO EXPANDS MOBILE RADIO PLANT.

text.p: Finnish telecommunications group Nokia Oy said in a statement on Wednesday it would expand its Aanekoski professional mobile radio plant and offices by 1,300 square metres by summer 1997.
"The project will be carried out in one phase and contruction will start in November this year," it said.
Nokia now has over 400 employees in Aanekoski, developing and manufacturing professional mobile radio products and in DX 200 related production and manufacture, it said.
